problem_type: Application and React Flow zoom limits diverge
symptom: The canvas slider offers 20% but stops at 50%, making the approved shot-table card density unreachable.
direct_cause: ReactFlow receives neither minZoom nor maxZoom, so its defaults override the app range used by fit and slider.
class_root: The viewport framework did not receive the domain zoom boundary.
affected_population: All canvas slider, wheel, and fit users

external_sources.purpose: Installed @xyflow/react/dist/esm/index.mjs:3279 confirms default minZoom .5 and maxZoom 2; zoomTo at522 delegates panZoom scaleTo.

internal_only_reason: Installed dependency source and pre-existing framework-boundaries.json minZoom/maxZoom debt inspected; no dependency upgrade.
invariants: The ReactFlow kernel, explicit fit, and slider use the same minimum and maximum zoom.
generality_proof: All viewport changes converge on ReactFlow panZoom; passing shared constants aligns wheel, slider, fit and keyboard.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Existing explicit min .2/max3 conflict with default framework .5/2.

recurrence.reason: Every zoom input and any new density consumer sees the conflicting ranges.
same_class_scan: CanvasNavigationStack range min/max and installed ReactFlow initialState defaults inspected

prevention.invariant: The ReactFlow kernel, explicit fit, and slider use the same minimum and maximum zoom.
prevention.failure_mode: Existing canWrite/pending proposal guards still reject foreign or stale writes.
prevention.strategy: Pass existing minimum and newly named existing maximum through one framework configuration; remove manual zoomTo clamp.

legacy_paths.rationale: No alternate implementation exists; the two unscoped calls are replaced in place.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The installed framework already supports the required minZoom/maxZoom props; no version change is needed.

migration: No persisted data migration; apply existing advertised 20–300 range to the kernel.
residual_risks: The full one-window replay stopped on a platform-dependent zoom action; same-profile continuation verified the remaining UI assertions. See docs/audit/2026-09-10-shot-table-storyboard-walk.md.
